Cuts thinking time between tool calls."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tool-turbo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Cut tool-call latency in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) by auto-adjusting `reasoning_effort` per tool roun"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"t tool-call latency in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) by auto-adjusting `reasoning_effort` per tool round.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"In a multi-step tool chain, the model re-thinks before **every** tool call — and that thinking domin"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ates the wall-clock time (a 50-step agent task can spend minutes in reasoning between tools). `dsh-t"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ool-turbo` watches the recent tool calls of a step and injects the *lowest sensible* reasoning effor"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"t into the next model request, then lifts it again the moment the work gets heavy."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DeepSeek's API exposes `reasoning_effort` in three steps (`low` / `high` / `max`, shipped 2026-08-13"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"). dsh re-resolves the request config for **every step** through an `agent/request` waterfall (see `"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts` — "plugins propose the next request config"). `dsh-tool-turbo"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"` plugs into that waterfall:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Watch** the step's recent `tool/call` records from the session.
2. **Decide**: simple, determin"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"istic tools (`write`, `read`, `grep`, `glob`, `bash`, `fs_*`, …) with small payloads → `low`; mixed/"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"heavy work → `high`; very heavy payloads → `max` (opt-in).
3. **Inject** the decision into the `agen"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"t/request` config for the next model call of that step."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Long tool chains keep the cheap rounds cheap, and never starve the hard rounds of reasoning."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Verified"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Injector works in a live dsh instance** (log lines from a real run):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **6/6 unit tests** on the effort policy (`decideEffort`): fresh prompt keeps the baseline, simple-"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"tool chains downgrade to `low`, downgrades respect the user toggle, heavy payloads upgrade to `max` "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"(opt-in), mixed tools lift to `high`.
